q: What is the name of the joint military exercise conducted between India and Nepal?
why: 'Surya Kiran' is the annual joint military exercise conducted between India and Nepal.

q: Which three banks in India retained their Domestic Systemically Important Bank (D-SIB) status as per the Reserve Bank of India?
options: SBI, HDFC Bank, and ICICI Bank
Punjab National Bank, Bank of Baroda, and Canara Bank
Axis Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, and SBI
ICICI Bank, IDBI Bank, and HDFC Bank

q: Which Indian state decided to provide rabies vaccination shots to frontline civic and high-risk workers?
why: The Tamil Nadu government announced rabies shots for frontline civic and animal care workers in high-risk jobs.

q: The Indian Army recently concluded the 13th edition of 'Operation DRISHTI' in Meerut. What was its main focus?
why: Operation DRISHTI was conducted by the Indian Army medical corps to perform 412 free eye surgeries.

q: Which organization has promised to ensure dedicated space for pedestrians and road users in Hyderabad by 2050?
why: HUMTA announced long-term plans to allocate proper road space for pedestrians in Hyderabad by 2050.
